intro: We built Luster for those who love to unwind in style. Adjustable, luxurious, and quietly powerful—it’s everything you didn’t know your evenings were missing.

features.title: Comfort, one touch away
features.text: With dual motors and a quiet touch mechanism, Luster lets you customise your recline and unwind your way—smooth, effortless, silent.

features.title: We move how you feel
features.text: Independently controlled back and footrest adjust to your body’s needs—because your comfort shouldn’t be one-size-fits-all.

features.title: Thoughtful storage, built in
features.text: Storage in the armrest and lift-up compartments keep the mess out of sight and your must-haves close at hand.

features.title: Support that’s got your back
features.text: We designed Luster with enhanced lumbar support that gently cradles the curve of your lower back—so every sit feels naturally aligned and deeply relaxing.

features.title: Cool to the touch, soft on your skin
features.text: Wrapped in Fab Leather, our sofa feels breathable and plush—perfect for warm weather and long sitting hours.

features.title: We bring function into flow
features.text: With a built-in USB port and adjustable headrest, it’s easy to stay plugged in and perfectly propped—no shifting required.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
